description: This file implements the ScriptCall class for handling RPC script calls in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including serialization, deserialization, and operator matching.

classes.name: ScriptCall
classes.description: Represents a scripted RPC call, supporting serialization/deserialization and operator matching.

methods.name: ScriptCall::toIValues
methods.description: Converts ScriptCall data into a vector of IValues for serialization.

methods.name: ScriptCall::fromIValues
methods.description: Constructs a ScriptCall object from a vector of IValues.

methods.name: ScriptCall::toMessageImpl
methods.description: Serializes the ScriptCall into a Message object for transmission.

methods.name: ScriptCall::fromMessage
methods.description: Deserializes a Message object back into a ScriptCall.

methods.name: ScriptCall::matchOperator
methods.description: Finds an operator matching a given schema string.
